budget_preserving_existence.type:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
  [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup Y] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℝ Y] [CompleteSpace Y] (T : H →L[ℝ] Y) (u : ℕ → H) (r : Y)
  (M : ℝ),
  (∀ (n : ℕ), ‖u n‖ ≤ M) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ‖T (u n) - r‖) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) → ∃ a, T a = r ∧ ‖a‖ ≤ M

equivalence.type:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
  [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup Y] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℝ Y] [CompleteSpace Y] (T : H →L[ℝ] Y) (r : Y),
  r ∈ Set.range ⇑T ↔ ∃ u M, (∀ (n : ℕ), ‖u n‖ ≤ M) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ‖T (u n) - r‖) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

escape.type:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
  [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup Y] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℝ Y] [CompleteSpace Y] (T : H →L[ℝ] Y) (u : ℕ → H),
  ∀ r ∉ Set.range ⇑T,
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => T (u n)) Filter.atTop (nhds r) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ‖u n‖) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop

construction.type:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace H]
  (A : ℕ → AffineSubspace ℝ H) (hne : ∀ (n : ℕ), (↑(A n)).Nonempty) (hc : ∀ (n : ℕ), IsClosed ↑(A n)) (n : ℕ),
  KomorebiSpace.NestedMinimumCorrections.IsMinimum (↑(A n))
    (KomorebiSpace.NestedMinimumCorrections.affineCorrections A hne hc n)

monotone.type:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace H]
  (A : ℕ → AffineSubspace ℝ H) (hne : ∀ (n : ℕ), (↑(A n)).Nonempty) (hc : ∀ (n : ℕ), IsClosed ↑(A n)),
  Antitone A → Monotone fun n => ‖KomorebiSpace.NestedMinimumCorrections.affineCorrections A hne hc n‖

finite_energy.type:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace H]
  (A : ℕ → AffineSubspace ℝ H) (hne : ∀ (n : ℕ), (↑(A n)).Nonempty) (hc : ∀ (n : ℕ), IsClosed ↑(A n)),
  Antitone A →
    ∀ {n m : ℕ},
      n ≤ m →
        ‖KomorebiSpace.NestedMinimumCorrections.affineCorrections A hne hc m -
                KomorebiSpace.NestedMinimumCorrections.affineCorrections A hne hc n‖ ^
            2 =
          ‖KomorebiSpace.NestedMinimumCorrections.affineCorrections A hne hc m‖ ^ 2 -
            ‖KomorebiSpace.NestedMinimumCorrections.affineCorrections A hne hc n‖ ^ 2

equivalence.type:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace H]
  (A : ℕ → AffineSubspace ℝ H) (hne : ∀ (n : ℕ), (↑(A n)).Nonempty) (hc : ∀ (n : ℕ), IsClosed ↑(A n)),
  Antitone A →
    ((∃ x, ∀ (n : ℕ), x ∈ A n) ↔
      ∃ M, ∀ (n : ℕ), ‖KomorebiSpace.NestedMinimumCorrections.affineCorrections A hne hc n‖ ≤ M)

strong_limit_unique_minimum_and_limit_en.type:
∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace H]
  (A : ℕ → AffineSubspace ℝ H) (hne : ∀ (n : ℕ), (↑(A n)).Nonempty) (hc : ∀ (n : ℕ), IsClosed ↑(A n)),
  Antitone A →
    (∃ M, ∀ (n : ℕ), ‖KomorebiSpace.NestedMinimumCorrections.affineCorrections A hne hc n‖ ≤ M) →
      ∃ aStar,
        Filter.Tendsto (KomorebiSpace.NestedMinimumCorrections.affineCorrections A hne hc) Filter.atTop (nhds aStar) ∧
          KomorebiSpace.NestedMinimumCorrections.IsMinimum (⋂ n, ↑(A n)) aStar ∧
            (∀ (b : H), KomorebiSpace.NestedMinimumCorrections.IsMinimum (⋂ n, ↑(A n)) b → b = aStar) ∧
              ∀ (n : ℕ),
                ‖aStar - KomorebiSpace.NestedMinimumCorrections.affineCorrections A hne hc n‖ ^ 2 =
                  ‖aStar‖ ^ 2 - ‖KomorebiSpace.NestedMinimumCorrections.affineCorrections A hne hc n‖ ^ 2

∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace H]

    (¬∃ x, ∀ (n : ℕ), x ∈ A n) →

        Filter.atTop

same_budget_exact_protected_candidate.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} {Z : Type u_3} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [CompleteSpace E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup Y] [inst_4 : InnerProductSpace ℝ Y] [CompleteSpace Y]
  [inst_6 : NormedAddCommGroup Z] [inst_7 : NormedSpace ℝ Z] (D : E →L[ℝ] Y) (p : E →L[ℝ] Z) (f : E) (u : ℕ → ↥(↑p).ker)
  (M : ℝ),
  (∀ (n : ℕ), ‖u n‖ ≤ M) →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ‖D ↑(u n) - D f‖) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) → ∃ y, D y = 0 ∧ p y = p f ∧ ‖f - y‖ ≤ M
